title: DishRedoRequestedEvent
description: Event emitted when a delivered dish is requested to be redone so Inventory validates stock and consumes FEFO.

eventId.description: Unique identifier of this redo request emission.

redoId.description: Unique identifier of this individual dish redo operation.

orderId.description: Public identifier of the affected order.

itemId.description: Public identifier of the delivered item line being redone.

plateId.description: Inventory plate/recipe identifier corresponding to Menu sourceId.

quantity.description: Quantity of the dish line to remake.

reason.description: Human-readable redo reason provided by the waiter.
